defmodule DocProcessor.CLI do
  @moduledoc """
  CLI tool for processing uploaded document metadata.
  Supports XML-based manifest files from enterprise clients.
  """

  def main(args) do
    {opts, _, _} = OptionParser.parse(args,
      switches: [input: :string, output: :string, mode: :string],
      aliases: [i: :input, o: :output, m: :mode]
    )

    input_path = Keyword.get(opts, :input, "manifest.xml")
    output_path = Keyword.get(opts, :output, "output.json")
    mode = Keyword.get(opts, :mode, "strict")

    case File.read(input_path) do
      {:ok, content} ->
        result = process_manifest(content, mode)
        write_output(result, output_path)
      {:error, reason} ->
        IO.puts(:stderr, "Error reading #{input_path}: #{reason}")
        System.halt(1)
    end
  end

  defp process_manifest(content, mode) do
    content
    |> sanitize_input(mode)
    |> parse_xml()
    |> extract_metadata()
  end

  defp sanitize_input(content, mode) do
    case mode do
      "strict" -> apply_strict_sanitization(content)
      "compat" -> apply_compat_sanitization(content)
      _ -> apply_strict_sanitization(content)
    end
  end

  defp apply_strict_sanitization(content) do
    # Remove processing instructions and suspicious patterns
    content
    |> String.replace(~r/<\?.*?\?>/s, "")
    |> remove_doctype_declarations()
  end

  defp apply_compat_sanitization(content) do
    # Compatibility mode: preserve structure but neutralize threats
    content
    |> neutralize_entities()
  end

  defp remove_doctype_declarations(content) do
    # Multi-pass removal to handle nested declarations
    cleaned = Regex.replace(~r/<!DOCTYPE[^>]*>/i, content, "")
    if cleaned == content, do: cleaned, else: remove_doctype_declarations(cleaned)
  end

  defp neutralize_entities(content) do
    # Replace ENTITY declarations but preserve DOCTYPE for schema validation
    # This allows internal entity references while blocking external ones
    content
    |> String.replace(~r/<!ENTITY\s+\w+\s+SYSTEM\s+["'][^"']*["']\s*>/i, "")
    |> String.replace(~r/<!ENTITY\s+\w+\s+PUBLIC\s+["'][^"']*["']\s+["'][^"']*["']\s*>/i, "")
  end

  defp parse_xml(content) do
    parser_opts = build_parser_options(content)
    case :xmerl_scan.string(String.to_charlist(content), parser_opts) do
      {doc, _rest} -> {:ok, doc}
      error -> {:error, "XML parsing failed: #{inspect(error)}"}
    end
  rescue
    e -> {:error, "XML parsing exception: #{inspect(e)}"}
  end

  defp build_parser_options(content) do
    base_opts = [
      {:space, :normalize},
      {:encoding, :utf8}
    ]

    # If content has a DOCTYPE, we need the fetch callback for schema resolution
    if has_doctype?(content) do
      base_opts ++ [{:fetch_fun, &fetch_callback/2}]
    else
      base_opts ++ [{:fetch_fun, &deny_fetch/2}]
    end
  end

  defp has_doctype?(content) do
    String.contains?(content, "<!DOCTYPE")
  end

  defp fetch_callback(uri, state) do
    # Allow fetching for schema validation from approved sources
    uri_string = to_string(uri)
    cond do
      approved_schema_source?(uri_string) ->
        case :httpc.request(:get, {uri, []}, [], []) do
          {:ok, {{_, 200, _}, _, body}} -> {:ok, {:string, body}, state}
          _ -> {:ok, {:string, ''}, state}
        end
      local_schema_path?(uri_string) ->
        case File.read(uri_string) do
          {:ok, data} -> {:ok, {:string, String.to_charlist(data)}, state}
          _ -> {:ok, {:string, ''}, state}
        end
      true ->
        {:ok, {:string, ''}, state}
    end
  end

  defp deny_fetch(_uri, state) do
    {:ok, {:string, ''}, state}
  end

  defp approved_schema_source?(uri) do
    approved_hosts = ["schemas.enterprise.local", "www.w3.org"]
    uri_parsed = URI.parse(uri)
    uri_parsed.host in approved_hosts
  end

  defp local_schema_path?(path) do
    normalized = Path.expand(path)
    String.starts_with?(normalized, Path.expand("./schemas/"))
  end

  defp extract_metadata({:ok, doc}) do
    # Extract document metadata fields
    title = extract_text(doc, '/manifest/metadata/title')
    author = extract_text(doc, '/manifest/metadata/author')
    version = extract_text(doc, '/manifest/metadata/version')
    files = extract_file_list(doc)

    %{
      title: title,
      author: author,
      version: version,
      files: files,
      processed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
    }
  end

  defp extract_metadata({:error, reason}) do
    %{error: reason}
  end

  defp extract_text(doc, xpath) do
    case :xmerl_xpath.string(String.to_charlist(xpath), doc) do
      [element | _] -> get_text_content(element)
      [] -> nil
    end
  rescue
    _ -> nil
  end

  defp get_text_content({:xmlElement, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, children, _, _, _}) do
    children
    |> Enum.map(&get_text_content/1)
    |> Enum.join("")
  end

  defp get_text_content({:xmlText, _, _, _, value, _}) do
    to_string(value)
  end

  defp get_text_content(_), do: ""

  defp extract_file_list(doc) do
    case :xmerl_xpath.string('/manifest/files/file', doc) do
      elements when is_list(elements) ->
        Enum.map(elements, fn elem -> extract_text(elem, './@name') end)
      _ -> []
    end
  rescue
    _ -> []
  end

  defp write_output(data, path) do
    json = Jason.encode!(data, pretty: true)
    File.write!(path, json)
    IO.puts("Output written to #{path}")
  end
end
